item.title: Natsu Dragneel - Come ON
item.media:title: Natsu Dragneel - Come ON
item.media:description:
My most recent artwork - made in 2022. My skills improve more when i don't draw at all for many months lol. Poured a lot of time into this to get the proportions right. This turned out just like i had envisioned. Fairy Tail was such a goated anime - underrated tbh. This scene was really cool and was stuck in my mind for 4-5 years till i decided to recreate it on paper. I used copic markers for the skin (finally got copic). Used brustro markers (good old friend) and prismacolor pencils (much needed upgrade from staedlter colorpencils).  I'm proud of this artwork and my mom got it printed on a mousepad which i use everyday. Thank you mom! The prisma color pencils and copic markers were gifted to me by my sister - thank you sis!!

PS: The flames look really cool right?

item.title: Shenron
item.media:title: Shenron
item.media:description: Made using staedlter color pencils. The shading between yellow and green turned out amazing to show Lord Shenron in all his glory. The dragon ball in the air looks great as well. I wasn't really a color pencil maestro when i made this but i gained a lot of confidence with the medium after this. This allowed me to use color pencils for future portraits that i made. Staedtler color pencils dont really melt and blend like prismacolor pencils but i'm glad i used these for most of my life since it made me learn about pressure and layers in color pencil artwork.

item.title: Goku vs Jiren Manga
item.media:title: Goku vs Jiren Manga
item.media:description: My first and only manga pages! This was the most fun to create artwork ever! I have utmost respect for manga creators because it is the most difficult thing to do! To communicate a banging fight sequence with just a few frames is insane! I used frames from the episode to create this. It was an amazing experience to use grey scale for the first time. Super Saiyan Blue Kaikoen looks great even in grey scale! I finally got to use my gray tone brustro markers set for this! I do want to make more manga artwork like this some day!

item.title: Dragon Ball Super Tournament of Power
item.media:title: Dragon Ball Super Tournament of Power
item.media:description: Boy did this drain the ink in my markers!! Big poster-like artworks look cool but are a waste of resources in my opinion. And although this probably is the highest-effort drawing of mine, it has a sub-par output. Probably because there are too many characters and I wasn't patient enough to make them all perfect. You can clearly see which characters I like more - the ones that look decent - Goku, Broly (Kale, but when i made this the episodes hadn't released), Android 17. This was a peak hype time when i made this, this arc was really good!

item.title: Bardock
item.media:title: Bardock
item.media:description:
One of my most perfect artworks. Especially the eyes and the face. There is always one wonky line in the face with dragon ball artworks of mine. This one I'm happy with. This is one of my first works with good quality alcohol based markers. Used the Brustro brand ones. The shining effect it gives on the skin and armor is amazing. The background blur is just soft pastels blended with my finger onto the page.

Fun Fact: This drawing was on the first page of a new artbook of mine at that time. The feeling of creating a really good piece of art (according to me at least) on that new book made me really happy. Here I am still riding that wave of happiness 5-6 years down the line.

item.title: Broly
item.media:title: Broly
item.media:description:
My first artwork with sketchpens. Back in 2015 or 2016. I used to make drawings and just use paint for the colors. Never thought that sketchpens could give a good effect till I watched Yair Sasson. Although he used special markers, I learnt the techniques and did my best with cheap sketchpens and color pencils that I had at that time.

Fun fact: I never thought about the scale of the drawing till I ran out of space. I had to stick an extra piece of paper to complete his legs, then cut out the whole thing and stuck it in the centre of a new page lol. I learnt to plan out the whole figure in advance and keep my drawing centred on a page after this.
